method: Deterministic headless simulation with a smart player targeting the lowest-HP enemy, grid-search ballistic aim, plasma when target HP >90, shield on round 2, repair below 70% HP. No movement or cluster used. Each mission starts with one charge of each ability and normal ammo.
budgetCheck: Combined hull/attack costs through level 4 are 2260 CR; missions 1-8 award 2640 CR before final mission. Earlier tested level steps also fit cumulative first-clear rewards.
interpretation: All missions are possible with earned upgrades. Mission 8 has the largest attrition pressure; movement, cluster attacks against adjacent enemies, a defensive tank, or higher hull level provide alternatives. These results establish feasibility for accurate play; they do not represent a human playtest or average success rate.
lifecycleChecks: repair cannot consume at full HP
controls disabled during projectile and after finish
